column1: # Overrides for tools/pathpatch (see its header). One line per site: rva  what...
# not road-network nodes: other structures with int16 pairs at +0x1c/+0x1e (a 0x18/0x1a pair; navmesh code)
# junction reads: the area id is the first word of the junction-ref entry found just before
# 0xf1ba10 is called with {junction*, region*}: the region's first node carries the area id
# 0xf0c280: one node's x/y loaded zero-extended into r9/r10 and sign-extended later from the 16-bit registers:
# loaded sign-extended with the origin (32-bit absolute), and the later movsx ebp, r10w / r9w become mov ebp, r10d / r9d
# 0x161b940: the pair loaded into xmm7 at 0x161c1fb is decoded at 0x161c401; the node pointer stays at [rsp + 0x98]
